primary.headline: Your Codebase Already Knows What to Test
primary.subheadline: Orbit reads your repo, understands your app, and generates a complete test suite — automatically. No test engineers. No hand-written scripts. Just tests that work, updated every time your code changes.

alternatives.headline: Ship Fast. Test Faster.
alternatives.subheadline: Orbit connects to your repo, maps your entire application, and runs AI-generated tests against your staging environment. Autonomous QA that actually understands your code.

alternatives.headline: The QA Engineer That Reads Your Code
alternatives.subheadline: Connect your repo once. Orbit indexes it, generates a test plan, and executes it in a real browser — continuously, intelligently, and without a single line of test code from you.

alternatives.headline: Stop Writing Tests. Start Shipping.
alternatives.subheadline: Orbit combines deep code analysis with live browser testing to find bugs before your users do. One connection, full coverage, zero maintenance.
